**Summary Bullet**: Generate exactly 1 bullet point summarizing ONLY explicit information written by the lead in this email: <<- Start Email {!$Input:EmailBody}. ->> End of Email ## Spelling & Locale You must use {!$Input:Lead.Lead_Locale__c} spelling and apply this consistently throughout the entire Summary Bullet. Format: - You must use the DATE {!$Input:Current_Date}. Return date in [YYYY-MM-DD] format. - [ {!$Input:Current_Date} in YYYY-MM-DD] Shape reference (placeholders only; do NOT copy content or dates): - [YYYY-MM-DD] Requested to be removed from further outreach If you cannot ground the bullet in something the lead actually wrote, do NOT create one — return an empty string for Summary Bullet. Build the **Updated Summary** value: 1: Read the existing {!$Input:Lead.LeadDescription__c} value from the lead data already in your context. 2: Extract the **prior bullets** from {!$Input:Lead.LeadDescription__c} (everything after "Nova's Update
"). 3: Assemble the **Updated Summary** as a single string by Concatenating: "Nova's Update
- " + [Summary Bullet] + [all prior bullets, unchanged] 4: If total bullets > 5, drop from the bottom (oldest) until 5 remain. Rules: - Preserve prior bullets exactly — do NOT rewrite, shorten, or summarize them - Start with literal text "Nova's Update" followed by
- Use
as line separator (field is Rich Text — plain newlines won't render) - Bullet starts with "- " (hyphen + space), not • - Use date in [YYYY-MM-DD] format — not the literal placeholder or an example date - Always return dates enclosed within square brackets using the format [YYYY-MM-DD]. Never return standalone dates without brackets. ## Output Format Return ONLY the **Updated Summary** value & "prior": **prior bullets**.
